description: All tickers consumed by rpi_fixings.py. Single source of truth — the Python module reads tickers directly from this file.

historical_series.label: RPI
historical_series.description: UK Retail Price Index — settlement index for GBP RPI inflation swaps

f_series.description: GBP RPI F-series calendar-month fixings (synthetic convention — Bloomberg does not publish monthly RPI fixings in this format). In live mode, derive from BPSWIS{n} Curncy standard-tenor RPI swaps interpolated to calendar months.

t_series.description: GBP RPI T-series calendar-month fixings (synthetic convention). See F-series note.

live_bloomberg_alternative.description: GBP RPI zero-coupon inflation swaps — standard tenors in years. Requires interpolation to convert to calendar-month YoY rates for level reconstruction.
